integrity: Standalone checker independently enumerates direct fixed chains and exact hook-character inner products over rational numbers; finite checks support but cannot replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational coordinate-permutation homology and hook multiplicities only; no preferred integral basis, equivariant sphere splitting or integral equivariant persistence classification. Wedge concentration is an earlier result; higher interior rank-span character and two-hook spectrum are the new scope.
title: All-rank symmetry characters and a sharp hook spectrum for Boolean filtered order complexes
